overall_goal: Log ingredient weights, clean the workspace, and put away clean dishes

goals.description: Log and prepare the onion and chilli
goals.rationale: The person uses a phone app to log the weights of the onion and chilli before moving them to the cutting board.

goals.description: Log and prepare the red pepper
goals.rationale: The person weighs the red pepper on the kitchen scale and records its nutritional value in the phone app.

goals.description: Store the chilli peppers in the refrigerator
goals.rationale: The person places the tupperware of chilli peppers into the refrigerator and closes the door.
The person retrieves garlic cloves, logs their measurements in the phone app, and moves them to the cutting board.

goals.description: Clean up food scraps and throw them in the trash
goals.rationale: The person gathers food scraps and packaging into a bowl and empties the contents into the trash can.

goals.description: Put away clean pots, pans, and colander from the drying rack
goals.rationale: The person takes various pots, pans, and a colander from the drying rack and stores them in the kitchen cabinets.

goals.description: Put away clean utensils and plates from the drying rack
goals.rationale: The person takes utensils, plates, and a knife from the drying rack and puts them away in drawers and holders.

goals.description: Manage the olive oil and pan
goals.rationale: The person retrieves olive oil, adds it to the pan, rolls it around, and puts the bottle away.

goals.description: Manage the oven and air fryer
goals.rationale: The person uses an oven mitt to interact with the oven and pulls out the air fryer tray to check the vegetables.

goals.description: Handle cooking utensils and adjust the stove
goals.rationale: The person retrieves and moves various utensils, handles pot lids, and adjusts the stove temperature.

goals.description: Clear and organize the kitchen counter
goals.rationale: The person shifts various items around the kitchen counter to create more workspace.
The person uses a paper towel to wipe food scraps off the kitchen counter into a small bowl.
